help.short: The entity state (ETag) version of the immutability policy to update must be returned to the server for all update operations. The ETag value must include the leading and trailing double quotes as returned by the service.
The name of the storage account within the specified resource group. Storage account names must be between 3 and 24 characters in length and use numbers and lower-case letters only.

The name of the blob container within the specified storage account. Blob container names must be between 3 and 63 characters in length and use numbers, lower-case letters and dash (-) only. Every dash (-) character must be immediately preceded and followed by a letter or number.
The name of the blob container immutabilityPolicy within the specified storage account. ImmutabilityPolicy Name must be 'default'

confirmation: Are you sure you want to perform this operation?
description: Delete an unlocked immutability policy. The response of delete has immutabilityPeriodSinceCreationInDays set to 0. ETag in If-Match is required for this operation. Deleting a locked immutability policy is not allowed, the only way is to delete the container after deleting all expired blobs inside the policy locked container.

operations.description: Aborts an unlocked immutability policy. The response of delete has immutabilityPeriodSinceCreationInDays set to 0. ETag in If-Match is required for this operation. Deleting a locked immutability policy is not allowed, the only way is to delete the container after deleting all expired blobs inside the policy locked container.

consts.name: api-version

props.description: Fully qualified resource ID for the resource. Ex - /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/{resourceProviderNamespace}/{resourceType}/{resourceName}
props.name: id

props.description: The properties of an ImmutabilityPolicy of a blob container.
props.name: properties

props.description: This property can only be changed for unlocked time-based retention policies. When enabled, new blocks can be written to an append blob while maintaining immutability protection and compliance. Only new blocks can be added and any existing blocks cannot be modified or deleted. This property cannot be changed with ExtendImmutabilityPolicy API.
props.name: allowProtectedAppendWrites

props.description: This property can only be changed for unlocked time-based retention policies. When enabled, new blocks can be written to both 'Append and Bock Blobs' while maintaining immutability protection and compliance. Only new blocks can be added and any existing blocks cannot be modified or deleted. This property cannot be changed with ExtendImmutabilityPolicy API. The 'allowProtectedAppendWrites' and 'allowProtectedAppendWritesAll' properties are mutually exclusive.
props.name: allowProtectedAppendWritesAll

props.description: The immutability period for the blobs in the container since the policy creation, in days.
props.name: immutabilityPeriodSinceCreationInDays

props.description: The ImmutabilityPolicy state of a blob container, possible values include: Locked and Unlocked.
props.name: state

props.description: The type of the resource. E.g. "Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines" or "Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts"
props.name: type

responses.description: OK -- Deletes container ImmutabilityPolicy operation completed successfully.
